theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M : Set (Eucl P)) (θ : Eucl P → ℝ) (ξ : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (f : Eucl P → ℝ) (L : ℝ≥0) (G : Eucl P → Eucl P), IsOpen U → IsRectifiableTriple U (m + 1) M θ ξ → LipschitzWith L f → (∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Eucl P), HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt (m + 1) M θ x Q → G x ∈ Q ∧ ∀ u ∈ Q, HasDerivAt (fun s : ℝ => f (x + s • u)) (inner ℝ (G x) u) 0) → ∃ (Φ : ℕ → Eucl (m + 1) → Eucl P) (Ω A : ℕ → Set (Eucl (m + 1))) (h : ℕ → Eucl (m + 1) → ℝ), (∀ j, IsOpen (Ω j)) ∧ (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (Φ j)) ∧ (∀ j, ∃ c : ℝ, 0 < c ∧ ∀ w ∈ Ω j, ∀ w' ∈ Ω j, c * ‖w - w'‖ ≤ ‖Φ j w - Φ j w'‖) ∧ (∀ j, A j ⊆ Ω j) ∧ (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (h j)) ∧ (∀ j, ∀ w ∈ A j, f (Φ j w) = h j w) ∧ (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)) (M \ ⋃ j, Φ j '' A j) = 0 ∧ ∀ᵐ x ∂((μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict M), ∀ j, ∀ w ∈ A j, Φ j w = x → HasWeightedApproximateTangentSpaceAt (m + 1) M θ x (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (Φ j) w).toLinearMap) ∧ G x ∈ LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ (Φ j) w).toLinearMap ∧ ∀ u : Eucl (m + 1), inner ℝ (G x) (fderiv ℝ (Φ j) w u) = fderiv ℝ (h j) w u
